card.line: Zorah was a town in the foothills, given to the tribe of Dan. It was the hometown of Samson and the place where he was buried.

moments.title: Manoah's family at Zorah
moments.text: A man named Manoah lived in Zorah, and his wife had no children. The angel of the LORD told her she would have a son who would begin to deliver Israel from the Philistines.

moments.title: The Spirit stirs Samson
moments.text: Samson grew up and the LORD blessed him. The Spirit of the LORD began to stir him at Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

moments.title: Danites send out spies
moments.text: The Danites had no land of their own yet, so they sent five men of valor from Zorah and Eshtaol to explore the land. The men came back and said the land was very good.

moments.title: Six hundred leave Zorah
moments.text: Six hundred armed Danites left Zorah and Eshtaol to take the land the spies had seen.

moments.title: Samson is buried
moments.text: After Samson died, his brothers and his father's family carried him back. They buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of his father Manoah.
